description: This file defines the DatabaseDriverList class in the Drupal core, responsible for managing and listing available database drivers, including discovering modules, filtering installable drivers, and handling driver namespaces.

classes.name: DatabaseDriverList
classes.description: Manages the list of available database drivers, including discovery, filtering, and ordering, within Drupal core.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DatabaseDriverList with root path, extension type, and cache interface.

methods.name: includeTestDrivers
methods.description: Sets whether to include test drivers in the discovery process.

methods.name: getExtensionDiscovery
methods.description: Returns an ExtensionDiscovery instance for scanning modules.

methods.name: doScanExtensions
methods.description: Performs scanning of modules to discover extensions.

methods.name: doList
methods.description: Returns a list of discovered database driver extensions.

methods.name: getInstallableList
methods.description: Returns a list of installable database drivers, prioritizing core MySQL driver.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to get the name of an extension.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a database driver extension by namespace, throws if name is not a namespace.

methods.name: getExtensionInfo
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to get info about an extension.

methods.name: getAllAvailableInfo
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to get info about all available extensions.

methods.name: getInstalledExtensionNames
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to get names of installed extensions.

methods.name: getAllInstalledInfo
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to get info about all installed extensions.

methods.name: recalculateInfo
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to recalculate extension info.

methods.name: getPathNames
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to get path names of extensions.

methods.name: recalculatePathNames
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to recalculate path names.

methods.name: setPathname
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to set the path name for an extension.

methods.name: getPathname
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to get the path name of an extension.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to get the path of an extension.

methods.name: createExtensionInfo
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to create extension info from an Extension object.

methods.name: checkIncompatibility
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to check extension incompatibility.

methods.name: sortByName
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to sort extensions by name.
